genuine_architecture_gaps_not_resolvable.reason: Proves the fully assembled Operator BFF app (all ~30 mounted routers) has no duplicate/shadowed routes; that is inherently a whole-app property. main.py is still the only module in the tree that assembles the full route surface -- core/app_factory.py's build_bff_app() only wires FastAPI + middleware and mounts zero domain routers (confirmed by reading app_factory.py and grepping for FastAPI()/create_app/build_app across the tree). No full composition-root seam exists outside main.py to point this file at without either duplicating main.py's ~30-router assembly in test code (forbidden: copied business logic) or narrowing scope to a fake subset (forbidden: fake app, would stop proving the real route table has no duplicates).

POST /bff/management/nl/ask (bff_management_nl_ask) is a large async handler defined and used only in main.py, composing prompt assembly, provider invocation, durable idempotency admission, attachment storage, and the composition-root-only Management AI audit trail (_MGMT_AI_AUDIT_EVENTS). A repo-wide grep found no standalone owner. This file's own module docstring (written under this same task) documents the finding in detail; this evidence file concurs after independent verification. Every other test in the file is already migrated onto real extracted owners (assistant/management_service.py, management_ai_store.py, core.app_factory.create_assistant_management_router).
